The convergence would ensure —

During the Budget Speech 2022, the Hon’ble Minister for Finance and Human Resource Management has announced that “recognizing the low enrolment ratio of girl students from Government schools in higher education, the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Memorial Marriage Assistance Scheme is being transformed as Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme. All girl students who studied from Classes 6” to 12" in Government schools will be paid Rs.1,000/- per month directly into their bank account till the uninterrupted completion of their undergraduate degree, diploma and ITI courses.
